name: Hopkins Creek State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite at 44.4821,-85.3212 (current + Wayback 2014 leaf-off z18): ~40x85 m clearing in conifer forest, creek never visible; USGS topo/OSM put Hopkins Creek ~20-50 m W under canopy; no per-site map (DNR has only the equestrian camp PDF) -> canopy-blind, default down

name: Lake Ann State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite + Wayback 2014/2018 at 44.713,-85.861: loops under closed beech-maple canopy, pads not resolved; DEM: campground plateau ~265-273 m vs Lake Ann 241 m = ~25-30 m bluff (climb-down); DNR Lake Ann Pathway map is overview only -> no qualifying source for shore or view sites

name: Lake Dubonnet State Forest Campground
evidence: Wayback 2014 leaf-off z18 at 44.683,-85.800: all loops legible, nearest ~70-80 m back from Lake Dubonnet/Platte arm through open hardwood on a bank ~20 m above (DEM 272-280 vs 254 m); the only shore clearing is boat-launch parking (z19); leaf-off sightline -> stays lakeview, not lakefront

name: Lake Marjory State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite z17-18 (current + Wayback 2020) at 44.8650,-84.6955: single loop on the lake's SOUTH shore (DNR 'north shore' is wrong; DNR coord = pin), RV parked ~55 m from water, pads ~50-75 m back across thin pine/hardwood with a shoreline tree band, ~6 m above lake -> lakeview, not lakefront

name: Kneff Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10218922: 27 sites, no Proximity to Water attribute; site coords plotted on satellite: nearest (10-12, Lower loop) ~50-60 m from Kneff Lake through jack pine/oak, loop ~25 m above the kettle lake (DEM 365-367 vs 341 m); 'centered around the lake' is prose -> not waterfront

name: Lake Hudson Recreation Area
evidence: satellite z18-19 (Wayback 2019, 2026): north-point sites (37/38 on DNR camp map) and east-loop north spurs ~25-30 m from Lake Hudson through a continuous wooded shore band (no apron) -> not lakefront; DNR page 'some sites have a lake view' + flat ground -> lakeview

name: Leverentz Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: pin was on the access road SE of the marsh; Wayback 2019 leaf-off z19 at 43.9083,-85.8198: campground road runs E-W between the lakes ~50-60 m S of Big Leverentz behind a shore conifer band, pier path at shore; leaf-on canopy; no per-site map (Sheep Ranch Pathway map is overview) -> not lakefront, view unproven but not contradicted

name: Little Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite z19 (Wayback 2014/2017/2019/2020) at 46.2816,-87.3340: central beach clearing with dock is day-use; one sandy campsite-size clearing NW of it ~17-25 m from the water with an open sand path to shore, but no RV/vehicle in any frame and no per-site map -> lakeview, lakefront not proven
